name: Knowledge base index
oneLiner: three paper documents drop above a glass knowledge base, each dives in and breaks into chunk tiles that fly into its columns of the grid, a light beam sweeps across and every chunk lights as the counter and bar run up, then the status rolls from Indexing to a green Ready
say: when the speaker says they gave the AI their own documents to learn from ('I loaded every doc we have', 'it reads all your files first'): the paper drops on 'documents', the chunks fly in as they explain, Ready lands on 'and now it knows'
